task_intent: Refine five Tessera music, conversation and arcade games with expressive native boards and matching wall compositions.

G13.query: Music guessing game with a short audio clip player, attempt progress and typed song answer

mobbin.observed: The listening quiz separates its large time indicator from the answer controls and round count.
mobbin.applied: A finite listening window on a record face, six compact equal-width hint segments, and direct playback and answer controls. No oversized proportional bars.

mobbin.observed: An audio readiness screen places a single clear action beneath a headphone illustration.
mobbin.applied: One unmistakable listen action with explicit loading, cancel, retry and playback states.

mobbin.observed: A question is paired with deliberate selectable answers and a clearly inactive Check action.
mobbin.applied: Composer action visibly requires a meaningful answer; submitted text remains until a matching server receipt.

primary.applied: Observe media position and actual time-control state; clip using the item's forwardPlaybackEndTime rather than a wall-clock sleep begun before buffering.
Stop and release the owned audio session on interruption, route loss, scene change and feature exit; do not resume audio unexpectedly.

G13.composition: The native board displays the actual 512px production wall artwork. The same record face and six-step geometry render at true 64 and 192 pixels. Controls and accessible history remain outside the artwork.

G15.query: Multiplayer trivia question screen with answer input, countdown, player scores and revealed answer

mobbin.observed: Round progress and countdown remain visible above the answers.
mobbin.applied: Persistent question number and remaining seconds anchor the question card, with a progress rule reflecting the configured duration.

mobbin.observed: A guessing screen separates correctness and points from the text composer.
mobbin.applied: Locked-answer receipts, a distinct answer reveal card and player score rows. Correctness and score changes publish together at reveal.

mobbin.observed: A compact progress rail and timer lead into a full readable question and stacked responses.
mobbin.applied: A full native question with readable Dynamic Type, an inline answer composer and a responsive vertical score list for up to eight players.

primary.applied: Inspiration for explicit answer judgment, scorekeeping and tie handling. Tessera is not implementing or claiming compliance with ACF tournament rules; its timed pub quiz reports an honest draw instead of choosing an arbitrary winner.

G15.composition: Native and wall use the same ink-blue question card, upper question number/countdown, gold duration rule, question text and mint answer reveal. At 64 pixels the actual question scrolls through a readable multiline region; long words wrap without dropping letters. Final scoreboards preserve all players.

validation.rgb_review: Inspected production RGB at 64, 192 and 512 pixels without smoothing, including scrolling question content and eight-player score bounds.
validation.native_review: Inspected normal and AX5 Heardle and Pub Quiz captures from the integration build. Core controls remain reachable; large text uses full-width composer buttons.
validation.hardware_note: Software RGB inspection does not certify physical LED colour. Parent task owns device deployment and hardware review.
